newsitem.title: USA: Epitope sees $1.4 mln Q4 revs from OraSure.
newsitem.headline: Epitope sees $1.4 mln Q4 revs from OraSure.

text.p: Epitope Inc said Tuesday it expects revenues from it's OraSure product to reach $1.4 million for the fourth quarter of 1996, twice that of the previous quarter.

OraSure is an oral HIV confirmatory test. The company said in a statement that it is continuing to make progress for U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval for an over the counter format of OraSure.
Shares of Epitope, which makes diagnostic products, were 1/2 higher at 14-1/8 in late trading on the American Stock Exchange.
